nameFormat.label: Name format

nav.downloaderDescription: Download beatmap sets from a list of links straight into your Songs folder, skipping the ones you have.
nav.exportCollectionsDescription: Save your collections as beatmap links, or as a list to import on another install.
nav.importCollectionsDescription: Bring collections from a file into osu!, merged with the ones you already have.
nav.exportSongFolderDescription: Filter your library by mode, status, stars, length and more, and export it as beatmap links.
nav.createPacksDescription: Put diffs from any sets, rates and unsubmitted maps too, into a pack of your own.
nav.trainerDescription: Change the rate, the stats, the long notes or the key count of the map selected in osu!.
